reason: The native adapters (OpenAI Responses, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock) read vendor stop outcomes as ordinary empty replies: a Claude safeguard refusal (HTTP 200, stop_reason refusal with stop_details.category), a Gemini promptFeedback block or SAFETY/RECITATION/BLOCKLIST/PROHIBITED_CONTENT/SPII candidate, a Bedrock guardrail_intervened/content_filtered stop, a Responses refusal part or status failed with an error, a malformed tool call (Gemini MALFORMED_FUNCTION_CALL/UNEXPECTED_TOOL_CALL, Bedrock malformed_tool_use/malformed_model_output) and model_context_window_exceeded all became text='' with no calls, so chat's routing step treated them as 'no tool needed' and synthesis re-asked and ended with 'no operator-facing answer after bounded recovery'. Responses also reported finish_reason 'incomplete' instead of max_output_tokens, so output-limit recovery never ran, raised 'malformed tool arguments' for a function_call cut off by the limit, and merged phase:commentary preamble into answer text. Each adapter now normalises these outcomes after parsing: blocks and bare refusals raise ProviderRefusalError (a ProviderResponseError subclass, 'provider blocked the response: <reason>'), a refusal with text returns that text, a malformed call raises ProviderMalformedToolCallError when the request offered tools and chat's routing step (both the required and the #487 automatic tool-choice calls) asks once more before failing the turn, context-window stops raise ProviderContextLengthError, Responses failed statuses are typed, finish_reason carries incomplete_details.reason, incomplete function_call items are skipped and commentary goes to reasoning. The SSE error frame no longer labels a refusal provider_final_answer_missing (which the client renders as 'Finish the answer' and hides the detail). tests/v3/test_native_adapter_outcomes.py (34 tests, 32 failing on origin/main 932719d; the other 2 guard ordinary stops) proves it, plus the existing parse, routing, tool-choice fallback, final-answer and stream-frame tests closest to the changed code.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through providers.py, chat.py and api.py) does not exercise vendor refusal, block or malformed-call outcomes, which need scripted vendor bodies; the Python tests drive the adapters, the chat tool loop and the SSE stream directly. test_providers.py, test_chat_tool_loop.py, test_chat_routing_tolerance.py, test_openai_compatible_robustness.py, test_native_adapter_requests.py, test_gemini_call_ids.py, test_provider_verification.py, test_reasoning_recovery.py, test_provider_contracts.py, test_chat.py, test_chat_api.py, test_specialist_routing_tolerance.py and test_openai_compatible_parameters.py were run locally in full and pass but are not selected. No full suites.
